subject: Stage sanity check + escalation readout — HorizonHealth Q3 commit
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@horizonhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage sanity check: Q3 commit readiness (HorizonHealth)

Sara — quick sanity check as we head into Q3 close. We want to ensure HorizonHealth is in a clean state to commit to the reserved capacity cadence we discussed. Can you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday?

- Target signature date for SOW / PO and who signs (billing entity)
- Procurement checklist items outstanding (SOC 2 report, IP addendum, PO format)
- Any internal finance approvals (credit review) that could delay July/Aug billing

I attached a short checklist for visibility (Q3-Horizon-Deal-Checklist.xlsx). If you prefer, we can lock a 20-min sync tomorrow morning to get the timeline aligned.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

From: Sara Lim <sara@horizonhealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.ai>, Michael Park <michael.park@horizonhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:08:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage sanity check: Q3 commit readiness (HorizonHealth)

Jonas — thanks for the checklist, very helpful. Quick answers below: 

- Expected sign date: Aug 12. Final signature will be by Michael Park (VP Finance).
- Procurement outstanding: SOC 2 Type II report (requested), updated DP Addendum (in legal review).
- Finance: credit review is in progress; likely cleared but we need an invoice example with payment terms (Net 45).

I'll upload the PO draft to procurement and share the SOC2 link when it's available (should be by Aug 9). Attaching a draft PO for your reference (horizon_po_v1.pdf).

— Sara
Sara Lim
Director, Product Integrations
HorizonHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:23:17 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage sanity check: Q3 commit readiness (HorizonHealth)

Jonas / team — summarizing risk and proposed next steps based on Sara's note: 

Current RYG assessment (pre-escalation)
- Stage: Contract review / procurement 
- Current color: YELLOW — SOC2 + DP addendum outstanding and finance needs invoice example/terms.
- Impact: Could push signature beyond Aug 12 if SOC2 link is delayed or if legal redlines extend.

Proposed save-plan actions (owners):
1) Legal / DP addendum: Naomi to get prioritized 1:1 with Horizon legal (owner: naomi.feldman) — target Aug 7
2) SOC2 evidence: Ask Sara to provide link by Aug 9; if not received, escalate to Michael Park and request interim assurance (owner: jonas_weber)
3) Finance pricing hold: Karthik to prepare invoice example with Net 45 and a short note on billing entity to unblock credit review (owner: karthik_iyer) — target Aug 6
4) Exec play: If key docs missing by Aug 9, prepare a one-pager escalation to present to Sales Ops + Finance to request a one-week sign extension and conditional reservation (owner: marissa_cole)

I've created a short internal checklist and linked it here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBzHorizonDealChecklist. Recommend we set a 15-min triage on Aug 6 to confirm whether to escalate.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:01:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage sanity check: Q3 commit readiness (HorizonHealth)

Couple quick asks from finance side: 

- I'll draft an invoice example showing Net 45 and the proposed billing entity (Redwood to receive PO to legal billing: Redwood Inference, Inc.). Will share by EOD today.
- If SOC2 is not available by Aug 9, recommend we escalate earlier (Aug 7) to avoid last-minute compression. Naomi — can you prioritize legal thread with Horizon?

If we get the invoice example and DP addendum traction, we can flip the status to GREEN and ask Sales Ops to reserve capacity.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Finance Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@horizonhealth.ai>, Michael Park <michael.park@horizonhealth.ai>, Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Stage sanity check + escalation readout — HorizonHealth Q3 commit

Team / Horizon — quick readout and next steps after our internal triage this AM.

- Status: STILL YELLOW (procurement docs + SOC2 pending)
- Immediate next steps: 
  * Naomi: please escalate DP addendum with Horizon legal and target a response by EOD Aug 7
  * Karthik: share invoice example (Net 45) with procurement to clear the credit check — target: EOD Aug 6 (thank you)
  * Jonas: I'll request SOC2 link by Aug 9 directly from Sara and will loop Michael if not received by then
  * Marissa: build the 1-page escalation pack (attached) we will use for Sales Ops / Finance if we need an extension.

I scheduled a 15-min triage for Aug 6 11:30 AM PT — calendar invite sent. If we cannot confirm SOC2 availability by Aug 9 we will escalate to Sales Ops for conditional reservation.

Attachments: escalation_onepager.pdf (internal)

Thanks everyone — let me know if anything else to add.

— Jonas
